correctness.rationale: For fully subdivided K_n, cut-edge subdivisions must be in any fort containing both original and omitted vertices. A fort without originals corresponds to an edge set with no degree-one vertices, whose minimal members are simple cycles. The other minimal forts are all originals and n mixed star-complements. Hitting all forts is equivalent to a nonempty original seed selection and a forest of omitted subdivision edges, except n forbidden original-singleton/star pairs. Labeled forest exponential formula proves all coefficients and Cayley gives n(n^{n-2}-1) minimum forcing seeds for n>=3. Independent verification: Independently enumerated forts and ordinary forcing processes on fully subdivided K_3 and K_4. The complete forcing polynomials had coefficients n=3 {2:6,3:18,4:15,5:6,6:1}, n=4 {4:60,5:156,6:178,7:116,8:45,9:10,10:1}; both matched fort categories and forest formula. Inspected verify.py; finite n is not all-n evidence.
